notes: Single source of truth for adapters. Run `node local/treasury/generate-adapters.mjs` after editing; tests fail when adapters drift from this file.
Argument shapes are NOT hardcoded here. Every call is validated against the inputSchema returned by tools/list from the server at call time.
permissions lists only what Stripe documents publicly. An empty list means the docs do not name permissions for that tool.

tools.name: stripe_api_search
tools.description: Search for Stripe API methods by keyword

tools.name: stripe_api_details
tools.description: Get detailed parameter information for a specific Stripe API method

tools.name: stripe_api_read
tools.description: Read data with any Stripe API GET method
permissions: Depends on the API method (read permission for that resource)

tools.name: stripe_api_write
tools.description: Write data with any Stripe API POST, PATCH, PUT and DELETE method
permissions: Depends on the API method (write permission for that resource)
tools.stripeHumanConfirmation: action_dependent (Create refund is marked Human confirmation)
tools.movesMoneyNote: Action-dependent; treated as money-moving because Create refund and other write methods can move funds

tools.name: atlas_company_formation
tools.description: Prepare or resume an Atlas application for a Delaware C corporation or LLC (lists, creates, retrieves and advances drafts; payment, signing and submission happen only in the Dashboard)

tools.name: stripe_analytics
tools.description: Query metrics, analyze subscriptions and billing, run financial reports, build SQL queries from natural language (metric queries are private preview; templates public preview)
tools.status: Preview (metric queries: private preview; subscription/billing templates: public preview)

tools.name: stripe_reports
tools.description: Searches financial report types and creates report runs (balance, payouts, activity, tax, Revenue Recognition) that produce CSV files
tools.status: Unconfirmed: named only in a search-index snapshot of docs.stripe.com/data/analyze-with-ai; absent from the current /mcp tools table. Adapter activates only if tools/list returns it.

tools.name: get_balance_summary
tools.description: Displays an interactive balance summary across the Stripe balance and Treasury accounts

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Converts funds between currencies within a Treasury account

tools.name: send_money
tools.description: Sends money from a Treasury account to a recipient

tools.name: setup_recipient
tools.description: Sets up a recipient account for sending money from a Treasury account

tools.name: transfer_money
tools.description: Transfers money between supported Stripe balances

tools.name: search_stripe_documentation
tools.description: Search the Stripe documentation for the given question and language

tools.name: stripe_implementation_planner
tools.description: Guides the user through Stripe products to accept payments, sell online, set up billing or build an integration

tools.name: send_stripe_feedback
tools.description: Share feedback about Stripe's products (sends a message to Stripe)

reconciledWith.result: 15 of 15 inventory tools present; registry adds stripe_reports as UNCONFIRMED; inventory labels the general tools public_preview but docs.stripe.com/mcp shows no preview label on them (only Treasury and stripe_analytics)

notices: Stripe MCP stops accepting full-access secret keys and restricted keys without the Agent tag in December 2026: migrate to agent API keys or OAuth by 2026-11-30 (https://docs.stripe.com/mcp#authenticate-stripe-mcp)
